configs.derivation: Analytic. Compact 6U-class 10 kg bus 0.1 x 0.2 x 0.3 m with six real faces, a -1 mm centre-of-mass offset along body y (physically produced by a positive linear mass-density gradient along y) and an in-plane 45 deg attitude with body-x spin. Optical coefficients 0.3/0.2, Cd 2.2 and Sentman accommodation 0.9 are explicit exploratory assumptions of this study, not mission data.
configs.inertia_derivation: Ix = m(b^2+c^2)/12 - m*d^2, Iy = m(a^2+c^2)/12, Iz = m(a^2+b^2)/12 - m*d^2, m=10, a=0.1, b=0.2, c=0.3, d=1e-3 m (parallel-axis shift from the offset centre of mass).

deviations_from_source: Torques are enabled here although MODEL_TORQUES=false in the cited example; enabling all torques is a declared requirement of this study.

The scalar Cr=1.7 is split into specular 0.6 / diffuse 0.15. This mapping is NOT unique: any pair with 1 + s + 2d/3 = 1.7 reproduces the same normal-incidence force. It is provisional and treated as an exploratory parameter, not a measured sail property.

The 9 m^2 sail is represented as one flat two-sided membrane (a +z and a -z panel sharing centre point {0,0,0.05} m), which is a geometric idealisation of a distributed membrane with a non-zero centre-of-pressure offset.
Inertia is the source's own idealised cross-brace/sail lumping, not a flight mass budget.

configs.conclusion: Sail area, arm length, reflectivity and lever arm are mutually inconsistent across the example set and the area does not track L^2 outside the cited file. No frozen mission specification is derived from this family. No externally citable Svarog mission requirement document was found; NASA ACSS3 and ESA sail-loading figures are context only, not the provenance of this case.
